strategy: The robot will navigate towards the target location by prioritizing forward movement while avoiding obstacles. If the forward path is blocked, it will check left and right directions in order, and stop if no safe path is available.

decisions.condition: Goal is ahead and path ahead is clear
Goal is ahead but path ahead is blocked
Goal is to the left and path left is clear
Goal is to the left but path left is blocked
Goal is to the right and path right is clear
Goal is to the right but path right is blocked

stop_conditions: Robot is at the target location
